Feature: Admin and Patient Information Management

  Scenario: Admin updates doctor's information
    Given the admin is logged into the system
    When the admin updates the doctor's information with name "Dr. John Doe" and specialty "Cardiology"
    Then the doctor's information in the system should be updated to name "Dr. John Doe" and specialty "Cardiology"

  Scenario: Admin updates lab/chemist information
    Given the admin is logged into the system
    When the admin updates the lab/chemist information with name "LabTech Inc." and location "City Hospital"
    Then the lab/chemist information in the system should be updated to name "LabTech Inc." and location "City Hospital"

  Scenario Outline: Patient updates personal details
    Given the patient is logged into the system
    When the patient updates their personal details with <name> and <email>
    Then the patient's personal details in the system should be updated to name "<name>" and email "<email>"

    Examples:
      | name          | email                | kind     |
      | John Doe      | john.doe@example.com | positive |
      | Jane Smith    | jane.smith@example.com | positive |
      | Invalid Name  | invalid-email        | negative |
      |               | jane.smith@example.com | negative |

  Scenario Outline: Patient creates an appointment
    Given the patient is logged into the system
    When the patient creates an appointment with doctor "Dr. John Doe" on <appointment_date>
    Then the appointment should be created and listed in the appointments tab with doctor "Dr. John Doe" on <appointment_date>

    Examples:
      | appointment_date | kind     |
      | as specified     | positive |
      | as specified     | boundary |
      | as specified     | negative |

  Scenario: Admin attempts to update non-existent doctor's information
    Given the admin is logged into the system
    When the admin attempts to update the doctor's information with non-existent ID
    Then the system should display an error message "Doctor not found"

  Scenario: Admin attempts to update non-existent lab/chemist information
    Given the admin is logged into the system
    When the admin attempts to update the lab/chemist information with non-existent ID
    Then the system should display an error message "Lab/Chemist not found"

  Scenario: Patient attempts to update with invalid email
    Given the patient is logged into the system
    When the patient updates their personal details with name "John Doe" and email "invalid-email"
    Then the system should display an error message "Invalid email format"

  Scenario: Patient attempts to create an appointment on a past date
    Given the patient is logged into the system
    When the patient creates an appointment with doctor "Dr. John Doe" on "2023-10-01"
    Then the system should display an error message "Appointment date must be in the future"
